title: Bunny reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Bunny body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#e8d8c8"/>
  <!-- Bunny head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="18" fill="#e8d8c8"/>
  <!-- Left ear -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="28" rx="6" ry="16" fill="#e8d8c8" transform="rotate(-10 38 28)"/>
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="28" rx="3" ry="12" fill="#f0a0b0" transform="rotate(-10 38 28)"/>
  <!-- Right ear -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="28" rx="6" ry="16" fill="#e8d8c8" transform="rotate(10 62 28)"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="28" rx="3" ry="12" fill="#f0a0b0" transform="rotate(10 62 28)"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="45" r="3" fill="#4a3040"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="45" r="3" fill="#4a3040"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="44" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="44" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="2.5" ry="1.8" fill="#f0a0b0"/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M50 54 Q47 57 45 56 M50 54 Q53 57 55 56" stroke="#c08090" stroke-width="1" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="50" r="3" fill="#f8c8d0" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="50" r="3" fill="#f8c8d0" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Book - open, held in front -->
  <!-- Left page -->
  <path d="M25 68 L50 72 L50 88 L25 84 Z" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#c8c8d8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Right page -->
  <path d="M50 72 L75 68 L75 84 L50 88 Z" fill="#f8f8ff" stroke="#c8c8d8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Book spine -->
  <line x1="50" y1="72" x2="50" y2="88" stroke="#c8c8d8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Book cover edges -->
  <path d="M24 67 L50 71 L50 73 L24 69 Z" fill="#6090d0"/>
  <path d="M76 67 L50 71 L50 73 L76 69 Z" fill="#6090d0"/>
  <path d="M24 85 L50 89 L50 91 L24 87 Z" fill="#6090d0"/>
  <path d="M76 85 L50 89 L50 91 L76 87 Z" fill="#6090d0"/>
  <!-- Text lines on left page -->
  <line x1="30" y1="73" x2="46" y2="75" stroke="#a0a0c0" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="30" y1="77" x2="46" y2="79" stroke="#a0a0c0" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="30" y1="81" x2="44" y2="83" stroke="#a0a0c0" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Text lines on right page -->
  <line x1="54" y1="75" x2="70" y2="73" stroke="#a0a0c0" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="79" x2="70" y2="77" stroke="#a0a0c0" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="56" y1="83" x2="70" y2="81" stroke="#a0a0c0" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Paws holding book -->
  <ellipse cx="27" cy="70" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#e8d8c8"/>
  <ellipse cx="73" cy="70" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#e8d8c8"/>
  <!-- Paw details -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="69" r="1.2" fill="#d0c0b0"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="69" r="1.2" fill="#d0c0b0"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="69" r="1.2" fill="#d0c0b0"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="69" r="1.2" fill="#d0c0b0"/>
  <!-- Fluffy tail -->
  <circle cx="72" cy="80" r="6" fill="#f8f0e8"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="78" r="3" fill="#ffffff"/>
</svg>
